summary: Ballard Power Systems filed a Form 6-K reporting a press release announcing a customer order for 15 MW of fuel cell systems (150 FCmove-HD+ modules) for stationary power applications. The order is a commercial contract from an existing customer, with deliveries expected in H2 2026. No financial terms, special-situation mechanics, board actions, or structural changes are disclosed. This is an ordinary-course business update with no acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special-situation trigger. Routine disclosure under Rule 13a-16.
